stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post worst day since June after Clarity Act vote fails
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs had their worst trading day since June, according to Decrypt, after the Clarity Act failed to pass a vote in Congress. The Act would have set clearer rules for digital assets. The failed vote appears to have shaken investor confidence in the near term.
stories.whyItMatters: Regulatory clarity has helped drive institutional ETF demand, so a stalled bill raises uncertainty for allocators watching this market.
whatToWatch: Next steps for the Clarity Act in Congress
Bitcoin ETF flow data over the coming days
questions: What exactly caused the vote to fail?
Will lawmakers bring a revised bill back for another vote?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote

stories.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory approval for institutional crypto custody
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank is waiting for regulatory sign-off before it can launch crypto custody services for institutional clients, according to Cointelegraph. The report does not specify a timeline or which regulator must approve the plan.
stories.whyItMatters: A major global bank entering crypto custody signals growing mainstream institutional interest in digital asset services.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of regulatory approval
A formal launch announcement from Deutsche Bank
questions: Which regulator needs to approve the service?
Which assets will the custody offering cover?

sources.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions

stories.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink and tokenized uranium
stories.summary: Anchorage Digital has added Etherlink and tokenized uranium to its institutional custody offerings, according to Cointelegraph. This extends the firm's custody business beyond mainstream crypto assets into newer tokenized products.
stories.whyItMatters: Custody providers moving into tokenized real-world assets points to growing institutional interest beyond standard crypto tokens.
whatToWatch: Client adoption of the new custody products
Growth of the Etherlink ecosystem
questions: Who are the initial clients for these offerings?
How is the tokenized uranium backed and verified?

stories.title: House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38-5 vote
stories.summary: The US House tax committee voted 38-5 to advance a crypto tax overhaul, according to Cointelegraph. The report does not detail the specific provisions of the bill.
stories.whyItMatters: Changes to crypto tax rules would directly affect how US holders and traders report transactions and calculate what they owe.
whatToWatch: A full House vote on the bill
Senate consideration of the measure

When would any new rules take effect?

stories.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token
stories.summary: Circle has launched the mainnet for Arc, a blockchain that uses its USDC stablecoin as the native gas token, according to Cointelegraph. This makes USDC the currency used to pay for transactions on the network.
stories.whyItMatters: A USDC-gas chain deepens stablecoin utility and could compete with existing blockchains for payments and DeFi activity.
whatToWatch: Early transaction volume on Arc
Which developers and apps deploy on the network first
questions: What consensus mechanism and validators run Arc?
How does Arc plan to compete with existing settlement chains?

stories.title: Tonkeeper rebrands to Keeper, adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron support
stories.summary: Tonkeeper has renamed itself Keeper and expanded its wallet beyond the TON network to support Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: Multi-chain wallet expansion reflects the ongoing push to offer users one wallet across multiple blockchain ecosystems.
whatToWatch: User adoption of the rebranded app
Further blockchain integrations
questions: Does the rebrand change the wallet's custody or security model?
Will TON-specific features carry over unchanged?

stories.title: UK eases rules for stablecoin payments while tightening crypto lending
stories.summary: The UK has introduced new rules that create an opening for stablecoin payments while tightening restrictions on crypto lending, according to CryptoSlate. The report does not specify further detail on the exact provisions.
stories.whyItMatters: The UK's split approach shows where regulators see the most risk in crypto markets: lending over payments.
whatToWatch: Formal implementation of the new rules
Industry reaction from stablecoin issuers and lending platforms
questions: What exactly is the stablecoin payments opening?
How will the crypto lending restrictions be enforced?

sources.title: UK opens a major loophole for stablecoin payments while clamping down on crypto lending

stories.title: Bitcoin's Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as Clarity Act vote weighs on US demand
stories.summary: The Coinbase Premium, a gauge of US buying demand for Bitcoin relative to other exchanges, fell to a monthly low, according to Cointelegraph. The report ties the drop to the failed Clarity Act vote squeezing US demand.
stories.whyItMatters: A weakening Coinbase Premium suggests US demand is cooling relative to global markets, a signal traders watch closely for price direction.
whatToWatch: Whether the premium recovers as regulatory developments unfold
Near-term Bitcoin price action
questions: How much of the drop is regulatory versus broader market conditions?

sources.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand

stories.title: Solana triples transaction size limit amid upgrades and record activity
stories.summary: Solana has tripled its transaction size limit as part of recent network upgrades, coinciding with record levels of network activity, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: A higher transaction size limit could support more complex on-chain applications as Solana pushes for higher throughput use cases.
whatToWatch: Real-world usage of the larger transaction size
Any further scaling upgrades to the network
questions: What specific upgrades enabled the increase?
Does the change involve tradeoffs for node operators?

stories.summary: A new Bitcoin Core software update has been released, aimed at improving speed and patching security issues, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin Core is the software run by most node operators, so updates to it directly affect network security and performance.
whatToWatch: How quickly node operators adopt the update

stories.title: Bernstein expects aggressive SEC and CFTC rulemaking after Clarity Act failure
stories.summary: Bernstein analysts expect the SEC and CFTC to pursue more aggressive rulemaking now that the Clarity Act has failed to pass, according to Cointelegraph.
stories.whyItMatters: With the bill stalled in Congress, agency-level rulemaking could become the main path for crypto regulation, shifting where the industry focuses its lobbying.
whatToWatch: Specific rule proposals from the SEC or CFTC
Industry response to any new agency rules
questions: Which rules might each agency prioritize first?
Could agency rulemaking cover the same ground the Clarity Act aimed to address?

stories.title: Bitcoin miners hold $100 billion in AI deals, but revenue has yet to show up
stories.summary: Bitcoin mining companies have signed roughly $100 billion worth of AI-related deals, but CryptoSlate reports almost none of that revenue has materialized yet.
stories.whyItMatters: Miners' pivot to AI data-center hosting is a major bet on diversifying beyond Bitcoin mining economics, and the revenue gap tests whether that bet is paying off.
whatToWatch: Timelines for these AI deals to start generating revenue
Upcoming miner earnings reports
questions: Which miners have the largest exposure to these deals?
What is causing the delay between signing and revenue?

sources.title: Bitcoin miners have amassed $100 billion of AI deals, but almost none of the revenue exists yet
